newsitem.title: USA: Apple to announce decision on Newton.
newsitem.headline: Apple to announce decision on Newton.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc will hold a press conference about its Newton handheld computer on Thursday, 1700 EDT/2200 GMT, an Apple spokeswoman said. Apple officials declined to elaborate.

Executives of the struggling computer company have been evaluating what to do with the Newton -- a handheld computer that stores addresses and phone numbers and receives e-mail -- for the past few months. Although the latest version of the device has been selling well, according to Apple, the company has said it needs to concentrate all its resources on developing new Macintosh computers and software.
Apple executives told Reuters earlier this month that they were seeking outside investors for the device. Analysts have said the company could spin off the product line into a seperate company.
